name: Saltoluokta-Sitojaure
description: Saltoluokta to Sitojaure. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official-source lane reported no public GPX surfaced and API publish_gpx=false, while route-geometry lane found a working direct GPX URL on 2026-04-29.
STF/Naturkartan give 19 km/19.0 km; STF Sitojaure page rounds Saltoluokta distance to about 20 km; computed Naturkartan GPX/API are about 19.6 km and OSM about 19.3 km.
STF endpoint is the mountain station at 67.3940893,18.5207608, while Naturkartan route endpoint is closer to shore/ferry access, about 200-215 m away.
Ultevis nature reserve/Natura 2000 overlap is confirmed, while Laponia/Stora Sjofallet national-park overlap for this exact stage was not directly proven.
Some field reports indicate abundant flowing water, while other secondary reports warn that convenient plateau refills are limited.
Older/secondary hints mention food/drink from water-taxi operators, but current STF evidence says Sitojaure has no shop.
STF boats page says June 19-September 14 until further notice, but the operator site still showed Season 2025 during research and direct fetch had availability issues.

facilities.name: STF Saltoluokta Mountain Station
facilities.description: High-confidence endpoint mountain station with lodging, restaurant/food, guest kitchen, shop, sauna, equipment rental, Wi-Fi/cafe context and M/S Langas access from Kebnats. Opening/service dates are seasonal; 2026 listed 2026-02-27 to 2026-04-19 and 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-20. A 2025-02-21 fire destroyed one guest building, with main building undamaged; capacity/booking pressure may be affected.
